title: Linear PM-tool adapter
summary: Reference PM-tool adapter for linking DontPanic plans to Linear issues and pushing plan status updates through the external integrations bridge.

auth: Linear API token or adapter-managed auth
config: adapter binary path and version pin

verify.readiness: Ready when a pinned Linear adapter is registered, its mapping validates against the PM-tool category contract, and dry-run status push can produce an external_sync evidence payload.

adapter: Printing Press generated Linear CLI or MCP server

mutation_boundary.allowed_path: DontPanic plan close/resync invokes the registered adapter for opted-in external_refs and writes durable external_sync evidence.
forbidden: Plan close blocked solely because Linear is unreachable
Adapter writes to plan files directly

notes: Linear is the reference implementation for the PM-tool category, not a core dependency.
Additional PM tools should use the same category contract before adding service-specific Python code.
